concerns.text: T014 (FeasibilityFilter) and T021 (Edge Case Handling) depend on optical flow magnitude to filter samples per FR-011, yet the task implementing this logic (T034-extended) is scheduled in Phase 5 (US3). This creates a circular dependency: US1 cannot filter data without motion labels that are not generated until US3. T014 and T021 must depend on T034-extended, or T034-extended must be moved to Phase 2.

T020 (Reporter) explicitly depends on T021 to generate `filtered_subset_manifest.json`. However, T021 is marked incomplete and depends on T015 (VLM verification). If T021 is not completed, T020 cannot legally consume the required manifest, breaking the US1 deliverable chain. T021 must be completed before T020 can be considered executable.

T024 and T025 (Latency measurement in runner.py) depend on T028-config and T028-logic to define the 50ms threshold and pass/fail logic. T028 is marked incomplete. Without these, the latency verification tasks have no defined criteria to execute against, rendering the US2 implementation untestable. T028 must precede T024/T025.

T033 (Sensitivity sweep) depends on T034-extended (Motion Labels) to verify `motion_labels.json` exists. T034-extended is marked incomplete. The sensitivity analysis cannot proceed without the ground-truth motion labels it is designed to sweep against. T034-extended must be completed before T033.

T007 (Data Loader) depends on T042b (Spec Amendment). While T042b is correctly placed in Phase 2, T007 is listed as [P] (parallel-safe). However, T007 cannot run in parallel with T042a/b if it strictly depends on the amended spec content. The [P] tag should be removed or the dependency clarified to ensure T042b completes first.
